customer_reply:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out to Zycus Support regarding error E-2207 when sending supplier agreements for e-signature.

This error typically occurs due to an expired integration credential. You can resolve this by following these steps:
1. Open Admin > Integrations > Credentials.
2. Regenerate the credential and update it in the connected system.
3. Trigger a manual sync and confirm the job status shows Completed.

Please let us know if you continue to experience issues after performing these steps.

Best regards,
Zycus Support
